coverage: Selected feature obligations from product scope and selected shipped declarations; not exhaustive product equivalence.

rows.requirement: Launch as an independent product without installed GoLand/PyCharm, commercial Go plugin binaries, or user IDE settings
Project tree, editor tabs, split editors, tool windows, resize and restored layout reproduce reference workflow
Caret, selection, multicaret, undo/redo and dirty-document close work reliably
Chinese IME composition, emoji, combining text and selection coordinates remain correct
Search Everywhere, file/symbol/action search, recent files and navigation history use reference shortcuts and focus behavior
Theme, font, keymap, settings search and Go settings follow platform conventions
Create/open/import Go module and discover SDK with clear errors
go.mod/go.sum/go.work project semantics and local replace dependencies work across modules
GOROOT/GOPATH/proxy/module environment/build tags/GOOS/GOARCH/CGO apply consistently
Tidy, vendor, sync, download and dependency errors have actionable UI
Go, go.mod/go.work, templates, build constraints and embedded language presentation are usable
Contextual and auto-import completion handles methods, interfaces, generics and incomplete code
Definition, implementation, references, type navigation, structure and call hierarchy resolve real symbols
Compiler-like errors, Go inspections and quick fixes update correctly after edits
Format, optimize imports and save actions preserve document/undo semantics
Rename symbols/packages safely with preview, conflicts and undo
Change signature updates callers and interface relationships with preview
Extract/inline/move declarations and introduce variable/type behave reliably
Generate interface methods, struct helpers and tests integrates with editor actions
Build-tag/OS/CGO files and multi-module scopes do not produce misleading references or diagnostics
Native Go Build configuration supports target, working directory, build flags, program args and environment
Context/gutter run configuration creation and persistence match Go workflow
Unit tests and table subtests form a navigable test tree with status, output and failure locations
Rerun test and failed tests select correct package/subtest scope
Benchmark and fuzz workflows support correct arguments, output and persistence
Coverage runs display file/line results and navigate uncovered code
Launch/test debugging supports breakpoints, steps, frames, variables and evaluation
Goroutines, thread filters, watches and variable presentation remain usable
Attach and remote debug use explicit target and lifecycle
CPU/memory/block/mutex pprof profiles can be generated/opened and linked to source
Embedded interactive terminal respects project cwd, SDK env, resize and process cleanup
Git status, diff, stage/commit/history and conflict navigation support real project workflow
Go vet and golangci-lint results provide navigation and configuration
Go template, JSON/YAML, Dockerfile, HTTP and SQL workflows used by Go projects have defined coverage
Project close, reload, tool crashes, cancellation and stale results do not lose data or leak workers
Startup, input, navigation/search/indexing and memory remain acceptable on representative Go repositories
